items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: He was there in the Rodzinski days and the George Szell days. That was quite a — he was quite an icon. He was a big deal to study with.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was there in the Rodzinski days and the George Szell days. That was quite a — he was quite an icon. He was a big deal to study with. And very, very strict. He was one of the last of the real task masters.
I see Frank Wess show up on your list of people that you’ve played with and studied with? How did that come about? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
